decoded_law.inactivity: a dimension is inactive exactly when target == NOM; SI round-trips still leave ~1e-17 phantom span deltas, so NOM equality - not iszero(delta) - decides who applies
decoded_law.moved_points: the moved set is role-aware: for SYM every listed point can move (REF2 always shifts, REF1 shifts when the raster gate fires); for ANC/RAD only the PS2 side moves (REF1 is the fixed anchor)
decoded_law.conflict: a point moved on the same axis and the same PS side by two non-sequential dimensions is a circular definition - intake-level, activity-independent
decoded_law.dependency: a non-sequential dimension whose reference lies on a moved point along its own axis is unorderable - circular for one-way and mutual crossings alike; cross-axis references are inert; sequential ANC dimensions may depend on anything
decoded_law.ordering: sequential ANC dimensions resolve last in dependency order (non-sequential movers first); same-axis sharing between an active ANC and an active non-sequential dimension is natively legal but the joint application order is still undecoded - conservative residual rejection

implementation_status: DiffMoM accepts reference sharing, cross-axis moved sharing and opposite-side sharing; rejects same-axis same-side non-sequential overlap, same-axis non-sequential dependencies (one-way and mutual), and keeps a loud residual for active ANC+non-sequential same-axis moved sharing whose joint ordering is undecoded. Inactive dimensions are decided by exact NOM equality, fixing phantom ~1e-17 deltas that previously registered false owners and conflicts.
